dedupe_keys.name: reperes de nivellement du canevas geodesique de rennes metropole

description: Repères de nivellement du canevas géodésique de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de points constitue un des éléments du canevas géodésique de Rennes Métropole. Pour information, un canevas est un ensemble de points géodésiques connus en position et servant d'ossature à la réalisation d'un levé topographique. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Référentiels géographiques. Its keywords are altitude. The portal shows 2,040 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
